_doc: Sect missions (G-008), taken by sect members via GameState.take_mission. Fields: id, name, description; sects: sect ids that offer it ([] or missing = every sect); min_rank: minimum sect rank index (default 0); min_realm: realm id (default mortal); min_stage: minimum stage index within min_realm (default 0, e.g. 4 = 5th Layer of Qi Refining; higher realms always qualify); kind: gather | hunt | deliver | guard; requires: {items: {item_id: count}} handed in (consumed) on completion; enemy: enemies.json id that must be beaten first (required for hunt and guard; losing fails the mission); days: time the mission takes besides any fight (>= 1); contribution: sect contribution earned (>= 0, may promote); rewards: shared Effects keys (items, qi, alignment, ...); cooldown_days: days after taking it before it can be taken again (default 0).

missions.name: Gather Spirit Herbs
missions.description: The sect's alchemy hall is short of common spirit herbs. Bring five.

missions.name: Cull the Mist Wolves
missions.description: A mist wolf has been stalking disciples on the mountain paths. Hunt it down.

missions.name: Deliver Cold Iron
missions.description: The armory needs cold iron for the disciples' blades.

missions.name: Escort Mortal Villagers
missions.description: Guard a column of mortal villagers past a bandit-infested pass.

missions.name: Purge a Demonic Cultivator
missions.description: A demonic cultivator has been draining mortals near the sect. Inner disciples are sent to end him.

missions.name: Harvest a Rogue Cultivator
missions.description: The sect's blood pools need fresh essence. A lone rogue cultivator will do.

missions.name: Blood Ginseng Tithe
missions.description: The Blood Elders demand a tithe of blood ginseng from their disciples.

missions.name: Guard a Pavilion Caravan
missions.description: A Pavilion caravan needs an escort through bandit country.

missions.name: Procure Azure Crystal
missions.description: A Pavilion client wants azure crystal. Find one, and the Pavilion pays you in standing.
